title: Rendered layout / overflow usability scan
description:
# Rendered layout / overflow usability scan

Parked under LIM-e872b1. Viewport overflow, tap-target geometry from computed boxes, broken responsive behavior.

**Blocked on a layout engine** (browser, Playwright, or similar). The current `limatus usability scan` parser has no cascade, no box model, and no viewport. Do not implement with more CSS string heuristics.

Stay `open` until that runtime exists. Do not start this against the static HTML parser.
